access_log_scope_note: HTTP access lines do not identify the API key; these counts cover all callers on only the two routes during the same time window.

relay_model_policy_readonly_check.note: Haiku-only scope was enforced by the test harness, not a gateway or relay key model allowlist. No policy change was made.

limitations: Persisted success means LiteLLM logging/transport success, not proof that the coding client accepted every stream event.
Missing cache read/write usage is not zero cache use. cache_hit=False is LiteLLM response-cache metadata, not provider prompt-cache usage.
Rows without a recorded target URL cannot be assigned to a route from persisted logs alone.
Snapshot is bounded by snapshot_utc; additional calls and delayed log writes may follow.

Source get_model_from_request returns None for a dispatched custom pass-through handler, so gateway-managed model allowlists do not restrict the body model here. The current test key also has models=[].

client_outcome_context.note: HTTP/persisted success does not imply successful SSE completion.

operation: One read-only final aggregation after test-owner reported completion; no inference, configuration, key or restart changes.
